config_state_mapping.interpretation: The Korean labels are not being translated into invented modern names: each is paired with the exact original Config.ini key and the object field changed by the click branch. slider_state_mapping.interpretation: Frame 751 is not an unnamed decorative knob. The first and second instances are the BGM and EffectSound level sliders. The original client stores the two levels in globals 0x008AB150/0x008AB14C, converts the 0..160 pixel-domain position using the original floating constants, writes Config.ini through the shared save helper 0x00441B30, and reloads the settings through the load chain 0x00441DA0-0x00441F37. The earlier 'call_va' values pointed at the SAVE chain (0x00441BEA-0x00441BF6 / 0x00441C18-0x00441C22); the corrected values above are the actual INI->global load sites (GetINI 0x00476xxx import -> atoi 0x004681F9 -> global store).

closed_notes.conclusion: The two volume globals are NOT consumed identically. EffectSoundLevel (0x008AB14C) IS read directly by the audio engine at play time: 0x0045BCE9 inside the per-sound volume/pan application 0x0045BC80 (eax = prior-term + level*40, clamp >= -10000, vtable+0x3C), which is invoked from the effect-sound setup path 0x0045B140 and the one-shot effect play path 0x0045B900; 0x0045B900 has six callers across gameplay/UI sound triggers (0x00457BA7, 0x00459240, 0x00459476, 0x00459AD6, 0x0045B032, 0x0045B074). BGMLevel (0x008AB150) has ZERO references in the audio engine: it is only touched by option-window code — config save read 0x00441C24, config load write 0x00441E5E (clamp at 0x00441E6C), slider-thumb recompute 0x00441EA4, and slider-drag write 0x00441F67 immediately followed by channel-volume apply 0x00441F6C calling 0x0045A700 on the BGM channel object 0x008AB658. The BGM playback paths (play-by-name 0x0045B250 with 'SOUND\' prefix at 0x0047D88C, stop 0x0045B3D0 -> 0x0045A510, enable-flag 0x0045B410/+0x56C, state query 0x0045B3F0 returning [channel+0x130]) never read 0x008AB150: BGM volume lives on the channel object and is re-applied only when the slider is dragged. So: EffectSoundLevel is consumed per-playback via the global; BGMLevel is consumed once, at drag time, via the channel object.

No text records, no fill bars, no overlay beyond the artwork; frame 751 (20x16 knob) is the only moving resource.

Registration (0,0) and ctor-baked (532,350) are irreconcilable as static absolute coordinates. The show dispatcher 0x0042B6A0 (13 callers 0x42BB4E..0x42BD67) receives x,y from the invoking message and 0x004240C0 computes a drag grab-offset from [+0x48]/[+0x4C] (an offset, not a move), so the real screen position is set dynamically at show time from message args. Therefore NO static absolute screen origin exists for this window; all coordinates here must stay relative/candidate until a runtime dump or message-flow proof pins the show-time origin. Register-flow mismatch itself is closed: registration origin is (0,0), ctor positions are baked, show-time position is dynamic.
